individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy time-lapse images, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a set of microscopy images, not a plot, so error bars are not applicable.

individual-data-points.explanation: The main graphs are time-course scatter/line plots where each point is an individual measurement over time; such line/scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The insets show averaged responses with vertical error bars on data points, but the caption never states what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, n).
